issue.title: Create View Project Page
issue.body: This is the view project page for the MVP. A user lands on this page if they tap a project on the Project List page. See #4 . ### Functional Requirements - Title: Show the project title - Subtitle: Show the target language - Show a back arrow which when tapped returns the user to the Project List page - Show each chapter in the project as a horizontal card - Each card should have - A folder icon (this is a placeholder and will indicate more information in later versions) - Title: Book Chapter - Subtitle: status of the chapter - Right arrow/caret - When the user taps on the card for a chapter, it should navigate to the view chapter page. - Note: This only addresses the happy path. We will address errors like failure to load data in the next iteration.
